entities.name: Crephas
entities.description: Felonarch of Inys Nohr and descendant of Nohr, who experimented with the broken leyline of the Clan Tree of Cridhe and was killed by his father around 3553 AR.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: Tree whose broken leyline Crephas used to mutate Nohrland's inhabitants.

entities.name: Curse
entities.description: Madness-inducing curse that afflicted Crephas and his father.

entities.name: Mirkalbion
entities.description: People created by Crephas, addicted to ardré fungus and enslaved in coal mines.

entities.name: Portis
entities.description: Elf mutated by Crephas, with green skin and leaf hair.

entities.name: Ruka
entities.description: Human given moth wings by Crephas.

events.summary: Crephas succeeds his father as Felonarch while the father is still alive.
events.quote: He succeeded his father as Felonarch while he was still alive.

events.summary: Crephas becomes obsessed with experimenting on the broken leyline of the Clan Tree of Cridhe, mutating Nohrland's inhabitants.
events.quote: using it to mutate the inhabitants of Nohrland

events.summary: Crephas creates the Mirkalbion, addicted slaves in the coal mines.
events.quote: He eventually created the Mirkalbion people who were addicted to the plant and served as slaves in the region's coal mines.

events.summary: Crephas and his father kill each other after going insane from the Curse around 3553 AR.
events.quote: Crephas killed and was killed by his father after they both went insane from the Curse around 3553 AR .

relations.quote: Crephas was the Felonarch of Inys Nohr
He eventually created the Mirkalbion people
